summary: Produced compilable TikZ (v2) reconstructing the figure: right triangle AOC with right angle at O (edges AO, OC, AC solid), point B on base AO joined to C by segment BC, labels A, B, C, O bound to their points. v1 had an extra right-angle square at O that the Critic and CV (detect_right_angle_marker found no square mark) did not support; v2 removed it. Critic scored v2 at 0.93 with no open issues.
